summary: Iter36 Customer Transaction History — end-to-end verification complete. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (5 iter36 + 7 supplementary iter36_extra). All summary keys (trip_count, total_qty, total_freight, total_diesel_received, total_advances, total_shortage, total_excess, total_halting, total_billed, total_received, outstanding, total_pending_uninvoiced) present. Filters (date_from/to, txn_type=all|trip|invoice|payment, invoice_status, payment_status, vehicle_number) all validated independently and combined. Trip POST/GET/PUT preserves customer_diesel_received + customer_advance_received. statement.pdf returns valid PDF (%PDF- magic, >500 bytes) with date-range params. share-statement returns whatsapp_url (https://wa.me/?text=...), whatsapp_text, and public_url which serves the PDF unauthenticated. transactions[] sorted DESC by date. Frontend Playwright: /customers/history renders split-panel with all 11 required testids (customer-search, customer-row-{id} ×9, download-statement-btn, share-statement-btn, customer-summary, filter-date-from/to/txn-type/inv-status/pay-status/vehicle/reset, transactions-table). Clicking customer updates URL to /customers/history/{id} without reload. 13 txn-row-trip-{id} rows load for TEST_Sup_Settle. Applying filter-txn-type=invoice reduces to 0 rows (customer has no invoices), filter-reset restores to 13. Vehicle filter (AP99EMP001) narrows to 1 row. Clicking txn-row-trip-{id} navigates to /trips/{id}/view. Sidebar nav-customer-history link present. /customers has 9 history-customer-{id} buttons that navigate to /customers/history/{id}. /trips/new shows 'Received From Customer' section with trip-customer-diesel + trip-customer-advance inputs which accept and retain numeric values.
critical_code_review_comments: customers.py /transactions endpoint correctly builds unified list from trips + invoices + payments with consistent {type, date, id, amount} shape and DESC sort — verified.
share-statement fallback to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env when backend env lacks BASE_URL works and returns HTTPS public URL — verified via unauthenticated PDF fetch.

TripForm 'Received From Customer' section wired with both new fields; payload transmits customer_diesel_received & customer_advance_received on POST and preserves them through PUT (round-trip test passes).

CustomerHistory.jsx split-panel implementation clean; filter reset properly clears all 6 filter states and refetches; row navigation dispatch by type (trip→/trips/{id}/view, invoice→/invoices/{id}, payment→/invoices/{invoice_id}) matches spec — trip path verified live, invoice/payment paths confirmed by code review (no invoices in tenant to exercise UI).

Minor UX observation (not a bug): For customers with 0 invoices, selecting filter-inv-status=invoiced or txn-type=payment yields empty table with no 'No data' hint — spec says empty is expected. Could be improved with a subtle empty-state chip.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (invoice/payment row-click paths verified by code review — tenant has no invoices)

seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up: customer TEST_Iter36Extra (retained), throwaway trips (all deleted via cleanup finally blocks). No data pollution.
